name: action-titles
description: Rewrite a deck's slide titles as the claim each slide proves — "Orders rose 17% in March to 5,480", not "Orders" — and flag every current title that claims more than its slide shows. Every number is on that slide; no cause, verdict or adjective the slide doesn't state. Reads .pptx or pasted slides; keeps the original title beside each suggestion; writes a retitled copy only when asked.
